integrity: The new implication is proved analytically from explicitly cited published lemmas. Search failure is not treated as proof of novelty, and a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent result is retained.
scientific limitations: The result is restricted to six independent exponential components and does not settle the conjecture for seven or more components. It relies on published auxiliary Lemmas A.1 and A.2 of Wang and Cheng, whose full proofs were inspected; numerical checks are supplementary.
title: The l-order likelihood-ratio conjecture holds for six exponential components
